A vitamin C supplement `provides ascorbic acid or mineral ascorbates to support collagen production, iron absorption, antioxidant defense, and immune cell function` . Most healthy adults get enough from food (recommended daily intake is 75 mg for women and 90 mg for men).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11ZfaYnODts-iOvMhDk175mzTmM3XsIvkQLtzN3HHMho9RStlbQV3gjACoFUVtwmYHoDXE_-k7Le1mmdWg0lsxxzpde3d97WCf_syiTUxXUDlC0S9ZoVh0_hN6uS8cPZXwIwEnliU5bNX5lRD0JMAapxZLy4Vzm4OhyfzA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXbufLfhL-SVoOyokZqhN0pB5gQdVAPrc7usR8pIt-Rx79tG6Epj-Ct8kq-kewEC19kfErDgGLd22RPAtkVUxcKrucR2c6GWDzrZ9CyR7kXlRAuqcNlOLCTt5WrQCEzoPm1dehUATgZAK_65-NYpJhxPWnJbBQbA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF15dPB_3hVn1XEJQkDV6JA-lpLMY5hdcMZ1gBDeA05zK7ZyFUU_OfH21YZmSJtm5oVnA_WOOLbTh-yYw8XQs0kgiyqI5EAI7w5bNY7XLOD7wQq0_yZv3wkxhCXXoCLsnrGtwhIY2zQ0BHzFXmYdNUjDo-fmR9_vxjEn2H73waEITwvqy0J41ZLy8)

### Common Forms & Formats

- **Ascorbic acid:** Standard, affordable, and similarly bioavailable to vitamin C in food.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXbufLfhL-SVoOyokZqhN0pB5gQdVAPrc7usR8pIt-Rx79tG6Epj-Ct8kq-kewEC19kfErDgGLd22RPAtkVUxcKrucR2c6GWDzrZ9CyR7kXlRAuqcNlOLCTt5WrQCEzoPm1dehUATgZAK_65-NYpJhxPWnJbBQbA)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o06D6btLJhM)
- **Buffered or mineral ascorbates (e.g., calcium or sodium ascorbate, Ester-C):** Gentler on the stomach for people prone to acid or digestive irritation.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o06D6btLJhM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXbufLfhL-SVoOyokZqhN0pB5gQdVAPrc7usR8pIt-Rx79tG6Epj-Ct8kq-kewEC19kfErDgGLd22RPAtkVUxcKrucR2c6GWDzrZ9CyR7kXlRAuqcNlOLCTt5WrQCEzoPm1dehUATgZAK_65-NYpJhxPWnJbBQbA)
- **Liposomal vitamin C:** Encased in fat-like bubbles; often higher cost and marketed for gentle absorption at higher doses.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o06D6btLJhM)
- **Delivery formats:** Capsules, tablets, chewables, gummies, and drink mix packets (such as options listed on [Target](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXroX9uaRu4APeg6Sz-gFf4r3LoLULWXsENzUmlcaDNAxKiUB5i2m1MXzIsXnzrZeyhvKRjqZRv4SbQJzeEiSOmdf2qtqMPyeUSrNL6xbRv3XSLkER9rRcEI-wJ7nqKCPIQwh9iuYzaPjGAQ)).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXroX9uaRu4APeg6Sz-gFf4r3LoLULWXsENzUmlcaDNAxKiUB5i2m1MXzIsXnzrZeyhvKRjqZRv4SbQJzeEiSOmdf2qtqMPyeUSrNL6xbRv3XSLkER9rRcEI-wJ7nqKCPIQwh9iuYzaPjGAQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11ZfaYnODts-iOvMhDk175mzTmM3XsIvkQLtzN3HHMho9RStlbQV3gjACoFUVtwmYHoDXE_-k7Le1mmdWg0lsxxzpde3d97WCf_syiTUxXUDlC0S9ZoVh0_hN6uS8cPZXwIwEnliU5bNX5lRD0JMAapxZLy4Vzm4OhyfzA)

### Benefits & Evidence

- **Collagen & skin/tissue health:** Required to make collagen for skin, blood vessels, cartilage, bones, and wound healing.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXYbmVXPK3AzOnDMRa0EvGQ038LttvSJqqWgGopDTvYO2RKaWsEDYHObzm1eym1pOXD-FYZGpvSXHseDbdtuu_ZtWFP2Rt8VHoJ6zqV2456eO1lSFL0CYTHwtxs-uw-BhiNtbU9kr-I97ldUCx1EKMnjbsAsRD4A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF15dPB_3hVn1XEJQkDV6JA-lpLMY5hdcMZ1gBDeA05zK7ZyFUU_OfH21YZmSJtm5oVnA_WOOLbTh-yYw8XQs0kgiyqI5EAI7w5bNY7XLOD7wQq0_yZv3wkxhCXXoCLsnrGtwhIY2zQ0BHzFXmYdNUjDo-fmR9_vxjEn2H73waEITwvqy0J41ZLy8)
- **Iron absorption:** Helps the body absorb non-heme (plant-based) iron.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11ZfaYnODts-iOvMhDk175mzTmM3XsIvkQLtzN3HHMho9RStlbQV3gjACoFUVtwmYHoDXE_-k7Le1mmdWg0lsxxzpde3d97WCf_syiTUxXUDlC0S9ZoVh0_hN6uS8cPZXwIwEnliU5bNX5lRD0JMAapxZLy4Vzm4OhyfzA)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/indfba/videos/why-is-vitaminc-essential-for-everyday-nutrition-vitamin-c-is-an-essential-nutri/808443082316629/)
- **Common cold:** Regular supplementation does not reliably prevent colds, though consistent daily use may slightly shorten cold duration or ease symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF15dPB_3hVn1XEJQkDV6JA-lpLMY5hdcMZ1gBDeA05zK7ZyFUU_OfH21YZmSJtm5oVnA_WOOLbTh-yYw8XQs0kgiyqI5EAI7w5bNY7XLOD7wQq0_yZv3wkxhCXXoCLsnrGtwhIY2zQ0BHzFXmYdNUjDo-fmR9_vxjEn2H73waEITwvqy0J41ZLy8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11ZfaYnODts-iOvMhDk175mzTmM3XsIvkQLtzN3HHMho9RStlbQV3gjACoFUVtwmYHoDXE_-k7Le1mmdWg0lsxxzpde3d97WCf_syiTUxXUDlC0S9ZoVh0_hN6uS8cPZXwIwEnliU5bNX5lRD0JMAapxZLy4Vzm4OhyfzA)
- **Eye health:** Combined with specific other nutrients in age-related macular degeneration (AMD) formulas, vitamin C helps slow AMD progression.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11ZfaYnODts-iOvMhDk175mzTmM3XsIvkQLtzN3HHMho9RStlbQV3gjACoFUVtwmYHoDXE_-k7Le1mmdWg0lsxxzpde3d97WCf_syiTUxXUDlC0S9ZoVh0_hN6uS8cPZXwIwEnliU5bNX5lRD0JMAapxZLy4Vzm4OhyfzA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXbufLfhL-SVoOyokZqhN0pB5gQdVAPrc7usR8pIt-Rx79tG6Epj-Ct8kq-kewEC19kfErDgGLd22RPAtkVUxcKrucR2c6GWDzrZ9CyR7kXlRAuqcNlOLCTt5WrQCEzoPm1dehUATgZAK_65-NYpJhxPWnJbBQbA)

### Safety, Side Effects & Deficiency

- **Side effects:** Taking high doses—especially over the 2,000 mg daily upper limit—can cause diarrhea, nausea, stomach cramps, and increased kidney stone risk in susceptible people. High doses can also affect certain lab tests or pose risks with G6PD deficiency. See [Mayo Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11ZfaYnODts-iOvMhDk175mzTmM3XsIvkQLtzN3HHMho9RStlbQV3gjACoFUVtwmYHoDXE_-k7Le1mmdWg0lsxxzpde3d97WCf_syiTUxXUDlC0S9ZoVh0_hN6uS8cPZXwIwEnliU5bNX5lRD0JMAapxZLy4Vzm4OhyfzA) for more safety details.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11ZfaYnODts-iOvMhDk175mzTmM3XsIvkQLtzN3HHMho9RStlbQV3gjACoFUVtwmYHoDXE_-k7Le1mmdWg0lsxxzpde3d97WCf_syiTUxXUDlC0S9ZoVh0_hN6uS8cPZXwIwEnliU5bNX5lRD0JMAapxZLy4Vzm4OhyfzA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF15dPB_3hVn1XEJQkDV6JA-lpLMY5hdcMZ1gBDeA05zK7ZyFUU_OfH21YZmSJtm5oVnA_WOOLbTh-yYw8XQs0kgiyqI5EAI7w5bNY7XLOD7wQq0_yZv3wkxhCXXoCLsnrGtwhIY2zQ0BHzFXmYdNUjDo-fmR9_vxjEn2H73waEITwvqy0J41ZLy8)
- **Deficiency:** Low intake (under ~10 mg/day) risks scurvy, with early signs including fatigue, gum inflammation/bleeding, joint pain, easy bruising, and slow wound healing.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11ZfaYnODts-iOvMhDk175mzTmM3XsIvkQLtzN3HHMho9RStlbQV3gjACoFUVtwmYHoDXE_-k7Le1mmdWg0lsxxzpde3d97WCf_syiTUxXUDlC0S9ZoVh0_hN6uS8cPZXwIwEnliU5bNX5lRD0JMAapxZLy4Vzm4OhyfzA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF15dPB_3hVn1XEJQkDV6JA-lpLMY5hdcMZ1gBDeA05zK7ZyFUU_OfH21YZmSJtm5oVnA_WOOLbTh-yYw8XQs0kgiyqI5EAI7w5bNY7XLOD7wQq0_yZv3wkxhCXXoCLsnrGtwhIY2zQ0BHzFXmYdNUjDo-fmR9_vxjEn2H73waEITwvqy0J41ZLy8)

### Food Sources

- Citrus fruits (oranges), bell peppers, strawberries, kiwi, broccoli, Brussels sprouts, tomatoes, and potatoes provide vitamin C alongside fiber and other nutrients.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11ZfaYnODts-iOvMhDk175mzTmM3XsIvkQLtzN3HHMho9RStlbQV3gjACoFUVtwmYHoDXE_-k7Le1mmdWg0lsxxzpde3d97WCf_syiTUxXUDlC0S9ZoVh0_hN6uS8cPZXwIwEnliU5bNX5lRD0JMAapxZLy4Vzm4OhyfzA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXYbmVXPK3AzOnDMRa0EvGQ038LttvSJqqWgGopDTvYO2RKaWsEDYHObzm1eym1pOXD-FYZGpvSXHseDbdtuu_ZtWFP2Rt8VHoJ6zqV2456eO1lSFL0CYTHwtxs-uw-BhiNtbU9kr-I97ldUCx1EKMnjbsAsRD4A)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o06D6btLJhM)

See [Mayo Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11ZfaYnODts-iOvMhDk175mzTmM3XsIvkQLtzN3HHMho9RStlbQV3gjACoFUVtwmYHoDXE_-k7Le1mmdWg0lsxxzpde3d97WCf_syiTUxXUDlC0S9ZoVh0_hN6uS8cPZXwIwEnliU5bNX5lRD0JMAapxZLy4Vzm4OhyfzA) for more safety details.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11ZfaYnODts-iOvMhDk175mzTmM3XsIvkQLtzN3HHMho9RStlbQV3gjACoFUVtwmYHoDXE_-k7Le1mmdWg0lsxxzpde3d97WCf_syiTUxXUDlC0S9ZoVh0_hN6uS8cPZXwIwEnliU5bNX5lRD0JMAapxZLy4Vzm4OhyfzA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF15dPB_3hVn1XEJQkDV6JA-lpLMY5hdcMZ1gBDeA05zK7ZyFUU_OfH21YZmSJtm5oVnA_WOOLbTh-yYw8XQs0kgiyqI5EAI7w5bNY7XLOD7wQq0_yZv3wkxhCXXoCLsnrGtwhIY2zQ0BHzFXmYdNUjDo-fmR9_vxjEn2H73waEITwvqy0J41ZLy8)
